phase: Tahap 1A - Project Foundation + Database + Login + Security
design_archetype: Swiss & Precision Finance Hybrid (Deep Slate Obsidian #0F172A with Emerald Trust #10B981 & Emerald Amber Amber Alerts)

hierarchy.h1_hero_login: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_dashboard_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.h3_section_title: text-lg sm:text-xl font-semibold tracking-normal text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200
hierarchy.body_regular: text-sm sm:text-base font-normal leading-relaxed text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300
hierarchy.label_overline: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous & Precision-Grid (2x spacing for card paddings and container breathing room)
layout_and_spacing.sidebar_width: w-64 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-xl
layout_and_spacing.topbar_height: h-16 flex items-center justify-between px-6 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-40

login_page.style: Split Screen (Left: High-contrast Dark Luxury Hero Banner with Indotech Financial Abstract Pattern + Security Badge; Right: Clean Auth Form with High Contrast Inputs and Loading Micro-Interactions)

left_banner.title: Rekap Piutang Otomatis Umkm & Enterprise
left_banner.description: Kelola penagihan, pantau umur piutang, dan percepat arus kas usaha Anda dengan keamanan enkripsi JWT standar perbankan.

form_elements.username_input: Shadcn Input customized with leading icon (User), floating focus ring, and data-testid='login-username-input'
form_elements.password_input: Shadcn Input customized with password visibility toggle button and data-testid='login-password-input'
form_elements.submit_button: Pill or crisp rectangular button with emerald glowing hover effect and data-testid='login-submit-button'
form_elements.error_alert: Shadcn Alert with Destructive styling and data-testid='login-error-message'

sidebar_nav.user_profile_footer: Active user avatar, name, role badge (Admin / Staff), and explicit Logout button with data-testid='logout-button'

header_topbar.right: JWT Session Timer Countdown Badge + Role Indicator Badge + Dark/Light Mode Switcher + Security Health Check status

security_indicator.details: Displays JWT Token Status (Active), Encryption Method (HS256/RS256), Session Expiry Counter, User IP/Device Log, and Security Level indicator.

user_role_management.features: Search bar, Role filter dropdown (Admin, Staff, Finance Manager), Add User dialog trigger, Status badge (Aktif / Nonaktif), and Action Menu (Edit Peran, Reset Password, Revoke Session)

component_guidelines.buttons: Always define explicit hover:text-white or hover:bg-slate-800. Use data-testid on every interactive button.
component_guidelines.dropdowns_and_popovers: NEVER use transparent backgrounds. Always apply bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 with border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-xl.
component_guidelines.toasts: Use Sonner for toasts (located at src/components/ui/sonner.jsx). Custom toast styles for session warnings and login success.
component_guidelines.cards: Subtle border, cardless or clean 1px stroke (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800), rounded-xl, no muddy gray gradients.

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer motion opacity fade and slight y-axis slide (0.2s ease-out)
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Active button scale-95 click feel, hover lift on cards (-translate-y-0.5)

testing_and_ids.rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

avatars.description: Financial Manager / System Admin Avatar (Indonesian Male Business Professional)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components follow React .jsx extension format (not .tsx).
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' or 'JetBrains Mono' for financial numerals and code.
Never leave dropdowns or headers with fully transparent backgrounds.
Keep interface language strictly in Bahasa Indonesia (e.g. 'Masuk', 'Kata Sandi', 'Peran', 'Pengguna', 'Status Sesi', 'Keluar').
Include JWT auth simulation or real backend integration with token storage in localStorage/cookies, handling 401 unauthenticated redirects.
Add 'data-testid' to every input, button, table, menu item, and alert card as specified in required_test_ids.
